# Runtime Theme Resource with Type Variations and Light/Dark Switching

## Background

Godot 4's GUI skinning system uses the `Theme` resource to drive how every `Control` node is rendered. A theme stores typed items (colors, fonts, font sizes, constants, icons, styleboxes), organized by *theme types* (e.g. `Button`, `Label`, `Panel`). On top of the built-in types, themes can declare **type variations**: named theme types that inherit from a base built-in type and override a subset of items. A `Control` opts into a variation by setting `theme_type_variation` (or by calling `set_theme_type_variation()`), and any unmatched item falls back to the base type.

In this task you will build a small Godot 4 project that constructs a `Theme` resource entirely at runtime (not via the inspector and not loaded from a `.tres`), wires it to a root `Control`, exposes a public API to swap between a "light" and a "dark" variant at runtime, and provides two custom button type variations: `PrimaryButton` and `DangerButton`.

Godot 4 (>= 4.3) is installed as the headless binary `godot` in `PATH`.

## Requirements

* The project root must be `/home/user/theme_lab` and contain a valid `project.godot` with the main scene set to `res://scenes/main.tscn`.
* The main scene `res://scenes/main.tscn` must have the following node hierarchy (names matter exactly):
  * `Root` (type `Control`) with the project's main script attached.
    * `MainPanel` (type `Panel`).
      * `TitleLabel` (type `Label`).
      * `DefaultButton` (type `Button`, no `theme_type_variation`).
      * `PrimaryButton` (type `Button`, `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`).
      * `DangerButton` (type `Button`, `theme_type_variation = "DangerButton"`).
* The main script must expose a public API on the `Root` node:
  * `apply_theme(mode: String) -> void` builds a brand-new `Theme` resource **at runtime via code** for the requested mode (`"light"` or `"dark"`) and assigns it to `Root.theme`. The theme MUST be constructed by GDScript on every call (not preloaded from a `.tres` resource file).
  * `get_current_mode() -> String` returns the last mode passed to `apply_theme` (`"light"` or `"dark"`). Before any call it must return `"light"`.
  * On `_ready`, the script must call `apply_theme("light")` so the scene starts in light mode.
* The runtime-built theme must register two type variations of base type `Button`:
  * `PrimaryButton` (variation of `Button`)
  * `DangerButton` (variation of `Button`)
    Use `Theme.set_type_variation(variation, base_type)` so that controls with `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"` inherit from `Button` and only override what `PrimaryButton` defines.
* For each Button-like theme type (`Button`, `PrimaryButton`, `DangerButton`), the theme must define three `StyleBoxFlat` styleboxes named `normal`, `hover`, and `pressed`, each with a distinct `bg_color`. The corner radius (all four corners equal) must match the values listed in Acceptance Criteria.
* For the `Panel` type, the theme must define one `StyleBoxFlat` named `panel` with the required `bg_color`.
* For `Button` and `Label`, the theme must define the `font_color` color item.
* Switching modes must be live: calling `apply_theme("dark")` after `apply_theme("light")` (or vice versa) must update every queryable theme item on every relevant control via `Control.get_theme_color(...)` and `Control.get_theme_stylebox(...)`. Do **not** rely on `add_theme_*_override`; the values must come from the assigned `Theme` resource itself.

## Implementation Hints

* Use `Theme.new()`, `StyleBoxFlat.new()`, and the typed setters on `Theme` (`set_color`, `set_stylebox`, `set_type_variation`). See https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/ui/gui_skinning.html and the `Theme` class reference.
* For a `StyleBoxFlat`, set `bg_color` and the four `corner_radius_*` properties (or call `set_corner_radius_all(radius)`).
* Variation lookup: when a control has `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`, `get_theme_stylebox("normal", "Button")` and `get_theme_stylebox("normal")` should both surface the `PrimaryButton.normal` stylebox if the theme has registered the variation correctly. Verifier queries will pass the control's expected theme type explicitly.
* Color values use Godot's `Color(hex_string)` constructor; compare them with a small tolerance (e.g. 1/255) when validating because hex strings round-trip through floats.
* Make sure the project loads cleanly headless: `godot --headless --path /home/user/theme_lab --quit` must exit with code 0 and produce no `SCRIPT ERROR` or `Parse Error`.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Project path: /home/user/theme\_lab

* The project must be a valid Godot 4 project. `project.godot` must set `run/main_scene="res://scenes/main.tscn"`.

* File layout (relative to project root):
  * `project.godot`
  * `scenes/main.tscn`
  * `scripts/main.gd` (attached to the `Root` node of `scenes/main.tscn`)

* `scenes/main.tscn` node tree (exact node names and types):
  * `Root` (Control) with `scripts/main.gd` attached.
  * `Root/MainPanel` (Panel).
  * `Root/MainPanel/TitleLabel` (Label).
  * `Root/MainPanel/DefaultButton` (Button), no `theme_type_variation`.
  * `Root/MainPanel/PrimaryButton` (Button), `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`.
  * `Root/MainPanel/DangerButton` (Button), `theme_type_variation = "DangerButton"`.

* Public API on `Root` (queried via the headless harness):
  * `apply_theme(mode: String) -> void` accepts `"light"` and `"dark"`.
  * `get_current_mode() -> String` returns `"light"` or `"dark"`.
  * On `_ready` the script self-applies the `"light"` mode.

* Theme values (each color comparison uses tolerance of 1/255 per channel; corner radius must match exactly as an integer in pixels). All values must be queryable through `Control.get_theme_color(name, theme_type)` and `Control.get_theme_stylebox(name, theme_type)` on the relevant control. Theme types: `Button`, `Label`, `Panel`, `PrimaryButton`, `DangerButton`.

extends Control

var _current_mode: String = "light"

func _ready() -> void:
	apply_theme("light")

func apply_theme(mode: String) -> void:
	_current_mode = mode
	var new_theme = Theme.new()
	
	# Register type variations
	new_theme.set_type_variation("PrimaryButton", "Button")
	new_theme.set_type_variation("DangerButton", "Button")
	
	if mode == "light":
		# Button
		new_theme.set_color("font_color", "Button", Color("#222222"))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#DDDDDD"), 4))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#CCCCCC"), 4))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#AAAAAA"), 4))
		
		# Label
		new_theme.set_color("font_color", "Label", Color("#222222"))
		
		# Panel
		new_theme.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", _create_stylebox(Color("#FFFFFF"), 0))
		
		# PrimaryButton
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#3366FF"), 8))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#2255EE"), 8))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#1144CC"), 8))
		
		# DangerButton
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#FF3333"), 12))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#EE2222"), 12))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#CC1111"), 12))
		
	elif mode == "dark":
		# Button
		new_theme.set_color("font_color", "Button", Color("#EEEEEE"))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#333333"), 4))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#444444"), 4))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "Button", _create_stylebox(Color("#222222"), 4))
		
		# Label
		new_theme.set_color("font_color", "Label", Color("#EEEEEE"))
		
		# Panel
		new_theme.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", _create_stylebox(Color("#111111"), 0))
		
		# PrimaryButton
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#6699FF"), 8))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#88AAFF"), 8))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "PrimaryButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#5588EE"), 8))
		
		# DangerButton
		new_theme.set_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#FF6666"), 12))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("hover", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#FF8888"), 12))
		new_theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "DangerButton", _create_stylebox(Color("#EE5555"), 12))

	self.theme = new_theme

func get_current_mode() -> String:
	return _current_mode

func _create_stylebox(bg: Color, radius: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = bg
	sb.corner_radius_top_left = radius
	sb.corner_radius_top_right = radius
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_right = radius
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_left = radius
	return sb

extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	print("Running theme lab automated tests...")
	var main_scene = load("res://scenes/main.tscn")
	if not main_scene:
		printerr("Failed to load main scene!")
		quit(1)
		return
		
	var root = main_scene.instantiate()
	if not root:
		printerr("Failed to instantiate main scene!")
		quit(1)
		return
		
	root_node_added(root)
	
	# Let's check get_current_mode()
	var mode = root.get_current_mode()
	if mode != "light":
		printerr("Expected current mode to be 'light' initially, got: ", mode)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Let's verify the nodes exist
	var main_panel = root.get_node("MainPanel")
	var title_label = root.get_node("MainPanel/TitleLabel")
	var default_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/DefaultButton")
	var primary_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/PrimaryButton")
	var danger_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/DangerButton")
	
	if not main_panel or not title_label or not default_button or not primary_button or not danger_button:
		printerr("One or more required nodes are missing!")
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Let's check light mode values
	print("Checking light mode theme values...")
	
	# Button / font_color
	var btn_font_color = default_button.get_theme_color("font_color", "Button")
	if not _color_approx_equal(btn_font_color, Color("#222222")):
		printerr("Button/font_color mismatch in light mode: ", btn_font_color)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Button / normal
	var btn_normal = default_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "Button") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not btn_normal:
		printerr("Button/normal stylebox missing in light mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(btn_normal.bg_color, Color("#DDDDDD")):
		printerr("Button/normal bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", btn_normal.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return
	if btn_normal.corner_radius_top_left != 4:
		printerr("Button/normal corner radius mismatch: ", btn_normal.corner_radius_top_left)
		quit(1)
		return

	# PrimaryButton / normal
	# Wait, if we query get_theme_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton") on primary_button, it should return the variation's stylebox.
	var prim_normal = primary_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not prim_normal:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal stylebox missing in light mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(prim_normal.bg_color, Color("#3366FF")):
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", prim_normal.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return
	if prim_normal.corner_radius_top_left != 8:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal corner radius mismatch: ", prim_normal.corner_radius_top_left)
		quit(1)
		return

	# Let's also check if query without theme_type uses the theme_type_variation property
	var prim_normal_auto = primary_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not prim_normal_auto:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal auto stylebox missing in light mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(prim_normal_auto.bg_color, Color("#3366FF")):
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal auto bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", prim_normal_auto.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return

	# Switch to dark mode
	print("Switching to dark mode...")
	root.apply_theme("dark")
	
	mode = root.get_current_mode()
	if mode != "dark":
		printerr("Expected current mode to be 'dark', got: ", mode)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Check dark mode values
	var btn_font_color_dark = default_button.get_theme_color("font_color", "Button")
	if not _color_approx_equal(btn_font_color_dark, Color("#EEEEEE")):
		printerr("Button/font_color mismatch in dark mode: ", btn_font_color_dark)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	var prim_normal_dark = primary_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not prim_normal_dark:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal stylebox missing in dark mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(prim_normal_dark.bg_color, Color("#6699FF")):
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal bg_color mismatch in dark mode: ", prim_normal_dark.bg_color)
		quit(1)

func run_tests() -> void:
	print("Running theme lab automated tests...")
	var main_scene = load("res://scenes/main.tscn")

	root_node_added(root)
	
	# Wait one more frame for _ready to be called since we just added it to the tree
	process_frame.connect(_on_test_frame.bind(root))

func _on_test_frame(root: Control) -> void:
	process_frame.disconnect(_on_test_frame)
	
	# Let's check get_current_mode()
	var mode = root.get_current_mode()
	if mode != "light":
		printerr("Expected current mode to be 'light' initially, got: ", mode)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Let's verify the nodes exist
	var main_panel = root.get_node("MainPanel")
	var title_label = root.get_node("MainPanel/TitleLabel")
	var default_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/DefaultButton")
	var primary_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/PrimaryButton")
	var danger_button = root.get_node("MainPanel/DangerButton")
	
	if not main_panel or not title_label or not default_button or not primary_button or not danger_button:
		printerr("One or more required nodes are missing!")
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Let's check light mode values
	print("Checking light mode theme values...")
	
	# Button / font_color
	var btn_font_color = default_button.get_theme_color("font_color", "Button")
	if not _color_approx_equal(btn_font_color, Color("#222222")):

		return
		
	# Button / normal
	var btn_normal = default_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "Button") as StyleBoxFlat

		return

		return

	# PrimaryButton / normal

		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(prim_normal.bg_color, Color("#3366FF")):
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", prim_normal.bg_color)

		return
	if prim_normal.corner_radius_top_left != 8:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal corner radius mismatch: ", prim_normal.corner_radius_top_left)
		quit(1)
		return

	# DangerButton / normal
	var danger_normal = danger_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not danger_normal:
		printerr("DangerButton/normal stylebox missing in light mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(danger_normal.bg_color, Color("#FF3333")):
		printerr("DangerButton/normal bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", danger_normal.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return
	if danger_normal.corner_radius_top_left != 12:
		printerr("DangerButton/normal corner radius mismatch in light mode: ", danger_normal.corner_radius_top_left)
		quit(1)
		return

	# Panel / panel
	var panel_sb = main_panel.get_theme_stylebox("panel", "Panel") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not panel_sb:
		printerr("Panel/panel stylebox missing in light mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(panel_sb.bg_color, Color("#FFFFFF")):
		printerr("Panel/panel bg_color mismatch in light mode: ", panel_sb.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return

	# Switch to dark mode
	print("Switching to dark mode...")
	root.apply_theme("dark")
	
	mode = root.get_current_mode()
	if mode != "dark":
		printerr("Expected current mode to be 'dark', got: ", mode)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	# Check dark mode values
	var btn_font_color_dark = default_button.get_theme_color("font_color", "Button")
	if not _color_approx_equal(btn_font_color_dark, Color("#EEEEEE")):
		printerr("Button/font_color mismatch in dark mode: ", btn_font_color_dark)
		quit(1)
		return
		
	var prim_normal_dark = primary_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not prim_normal_dark:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal stylebox missing in dark mode")
		quit(1)
		return
	if not _color_approx_equal(prim_normal_dark.bg_color, Color("#6699FF")):
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal bg_color mismatch in dark mode: ", prim_normal_dark.bg_color)
		quit(1)
		return
	if prim_normal_dark.corner_radius_top_left != 8:
		printerr("PrimaryButton/normal corner radius mismatch in dark mode: ", prim_normal_dark.corner_radius_top_left)
		quit(1)
		return

	var danger_normal_dark = danger_button.get_theme_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not danger_normal_dark:
		printerr("DangerButton/normal stylebox missing in dark mode")
		quit(1)

		printerr("DangerButton/normal bg_color mismatch in dark mode: ", danger_normal_dark.bg_color)

		return

	quit(0)
